reviews.title: Pretty decent board, kind of unremarkable but a decent budget choice if you're stuck with DDR4
reviews.comment:
This board isn't bad. It installed easily and it's been solid since. It acted a little weird on the first boot but I just had to let it sit running overnight to figure itself out. It isn't equipped to handle the heat generated from really powerful CPUs, so make sure yours is compatible first. It works great with my 12600KF budget build. It's pretty barebones though and doesn't have a ton of features, so make sure it has everything your case and fans need before you buy.
Now, the complaints: the BIOS feels genuinely terrible to use. It's laggy, and the mouse just feels bad. It has enough basic features for a simple budget build, but lacks a lot of the fancier stuff you'd get from nicer boards. It also only had one USB 3.0 port on the back, which is kind of awful. Make sure you get a PCIe USB 3.0 expansion with this board if you think you'll ever need it.
Overall, this board is fine. It gets the job done, but I wish I would have done a bit more shopping before committing. As an alternative, I would recommend the ASUS B760M AYW instead. It has 2 less RAM slots and 1 less fan header, but the BIOS feels way better to use and it just booted up and started working immediately for the exact same price.
